main.content:
==English==
{{wp}}

===Etymology===
{{etymon|en|:bor|frm:<ety:inh<fro:moderacion<ety:inh<la:moderātiō>>>>|tree=+|text=*}} {{surf|en|moderate|ion}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{enPR|mŏd'ə-rāʹ-shən|a=GA}}; {{IPA|en|/ˌmɑdəˈɹeɪʃən/}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˌmɒdəˈɹeɪʃən/|a=RP}}
** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-moderation.wav|a=Southern England}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Wodencafe-moderation.wav|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|eɪʃən|s=4}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|~}}

# The state or quality of being [[moderate]]; avoidance of extremes. 
#* {{quote-book|en
|passage=...It regulates and governs the Passions of the Mind, and brings them into due '''moderation''' and frame...
|page=17
|title=An Account of the Growth of Deism in England
|author=William Stephens
|year=1696}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2008|author={{w|Christopher Paolini}} |title={{w|Brisingr}} |chapter=To Walk the Land Alone |page=75 |text='''Moderation''' is a wiser policy than zealotry, I think.}}
# An instance of [[moderate|moderating]]: bringing something away from extremes, especially in a [[beneficial]] way. 
#* {{quote-journal|en|year=1936|month=March|work=The Southern Lumberman|url=http://books.google.com/books?id=m67kAAAAMAAJ|page=34
|passage=With the quick '''moderation''' of the weather some buying has appeared that had been held up because of the extremely cold weather {{...|experienced the first part of January and most of February}}.}}
# The process of [[moderate|moderating]] a discussion. 
#: {{ux|en|The '''moderation''' of a large online forum can be hard work.}}
# Usage of neutron moderator to slow down neutrons in a nuclear reactor.
